single.rationale: Royalty Pharma operates a capital-light business model with exceptional cash generation (>100% operating cash flow conversion) and dominant market share (48% of royalty market, 69% of large deals). However, flat revenue growth (~2% CAGR), rising leverage ($8.3B net debt, up $1.4B in one year), and binary development-stage risks create uncertainty around near-term value creation despite strong structural position.
